scope.excluded: No figure, component, registry, demo, or asset file was edited by the writer.

contract.model_gate: The user explicitly overrode only the Fable-only gate; all other lesson-factory and lesson-author rules were applied.
contract.single_move: Separate isolated-peak localization by dense DTFT sampling and a checked local fit from multi-component resolution supplied by observation, window, or model evidence.
contract.notation: N is acquired/windowed length; L is FFT/evaluation length; signals are analytic complex unless the real-cosine translation is explicit.
keeper_quantities: L/N=16 changes the grid from 1 original bin to 1/16 without changing the 64-sample record.
The frozen warm-up gives p=1/6, a +1.6667 Hz correction, and fitted height 0.25 dB.
Increasing N from 64 to 256 at fixed fs narrows the periodic-Hann main lobe from 64 Hz to 16 Hz.

PASS: every Exercise has a complete Solution and References is last.

weakest_section.name: Padding reduces grid error until the peak model becomes the limit
